name: EPIC 246238040

text.card: A red giant 3,974 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.88 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,617 K at its surface.
